subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider after Google’s Vertex AI naming change?
rationale: Source proves the visible copy is old, but the exact replacement wording is a product/docs choice and provider-id renames would affect compatibility.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update only user-facing labels and docs to bridge the new official name with the stable existing provider id.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave current labels until maintainers decide Google’s new naming is stable enough for OpenClaw UI/docs.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Adopt the reporter’s shorter wording even though it is not the exact official wording found in current docs.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update only user-facing labels and docs to bridge the new official name with the stable existing provider id.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining blocker is a UI/docs label decision, and the issue discussion specifically routed that choice to this login.
